decks.name: LeetCode #2 - Add Two Numbers
decks.description: Add two numbers represented as linked lists in reverse order

cards.question: Add Two Numbers: You are given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers. The digits are stored in reverse order, and each of their nodes contains a single digit. Add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list. You may assume the two numbers do not contain any leading zero, except the number 0 itself.

solutions.name: Iteration
solutions.explanation: Use dummy head and iterate through both lists simultaneously, calculating sum with carry at each position. Continue while either list has nodes or carry exists. Most efficient with O(1) extra space.
